title: Caramelised Carrot, Chickpea & Chicken Salad
description: Air-fried caramelised carrots, chickpeas and chicken breast tossed in a lemony tahini-yogurt dressing with fresh parsley.
ingredients: 200g canned chickpeas, drained and rinsed (about 1 1/4 cups)
instructions: Pat the 450g chicken breast dry and season with the 1/2 tsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp black pepper.
Air fry the 450g seasoned chicken breast at 380°F for 18-22 minutes, flipping halfway, until it reaches 165°F internally. Rest 5 minutes, then cut into bite-sized chunks.
While the chicken cooks, trim the ends from the 400g carrots and cut into 2cm chunks. Toss with the 1 tsp canola oil and the remaining 1/4 tsp salt.
Air fry the 400g carrots at 400°F for 18-20 minutes, shaking halfway, until softened and caramelised at the edges. Let cool for 10 minutes.

Make the dressing: in a small bowl, stir together the 150g Greek yogurt, 1 tbsp tahini, 1/2 grated garlic clove and the juice of 1/2 lemon (about 1 1/2 tbsp lemon juice). Thin with 1-2 tbsp water until pourable, then season to taste.
Add the 200g drained chickpeas to a large bowl with the cooled 400g roasted carrots, the chopped 450g cooked chicken breast and the 25g chopped parsley.
Drizzle over all of the dressing (made from the 150g Greek yogurt and 1 tbsp tahini) and toss to combine.
notes: Protein density: ~11.5g protein per 100 kcal. For meal prep, divide the dressing into 3 small containers and toss just before eating so the parsley stays fresh. Swap half the chickpeas for 1 cup shelled edamame for a higher protein ratio.
